name: get_calendar_context
description: This tool belongs to the EnterpriseCalendarAPI mock. Tool description: Return simulated current time and the current calendar week (inclusive dates). Use this to interpret phrases like "next week" or "tomorrow" relative to the scenario clock. Also returns current_user_name when set in metadata. Does not include meeting duration, attendee list, or working-hour — those come from the user request.

simulated_now_iso.description: Naive local wall time for the simulated now (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), interpreted in simulated_now_timezone.

current_week_start_date.description: First day of the current calendar week (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

current_week_end_date.description: Last day of the current calendar week (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

current_user_name.description: Display name of the current user (the person asking the question), if set in metadata.

name: get_user_schedule
description: This tool belongs to the EnterpriseCalendarAPI mock. Tool description: Convenience wrapper that returns the current user's calendar events for a given date range without needing to know the user's name explicitly. The user's display name is read from metadata["current_user_name"]. Returns an error if current_user_name is not set. The response structure is identical to get_schedule_by_employee_name.

start_date.description: Range start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), local to the current user.

end_date.description: Range end calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), local to the current user.

employee_id.description: Internal id of the current user.

display_name.description: Display name of the current user.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the current user's stored events.

rsvp.description: RSVP status e.g. accepted, tentative, declined.

name: get_schedule_by_employee_name
description: This tool belongs to the EnterpriseCalendarAPI mock. Tool description: Look up one employee by display name (case-insensitive) and return their scheduled blocks in that employee's own local timezone, with RSVP status. Times in storage are wall times in that employee's zone. Filter events overlapping the inclusive local date range start_date..end_date.

start_date.description: Range start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), local to that employee.

end_date.description: Range end calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), local to that employee.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for this employee's stored events.

rsvp.description: RSVP status e.g. accepted, tentative, declined.

name: convert_datetime_between_timezones
description: This tool belongs to the EnterpriseCalendarAPI mock. Tool description: Interpret a naive local datetime as wall time in source_timezone, then return the same instant as UTC ISO and as local wall time in target_timezone. Use IANA names (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London).

target_local_iso.description: Same instant as local wall time in target zone.

name: book_event
description: This tool belongs to the EnterpriseCalendarAPI mock. Tool description: Book a calendar event for two or more attendees at a given UTC start time. Creates events on every attendee's calendar in their respective local timezones. Validates that all names exist and checks for scheduling conflicts against all existing events for every attendee. Returns an error if any attendee is unknown or has a conflicting event in the proposed time window. On success, returns local times for all attendees.

attendee_names.description: Display names of all attendees (case-insensitive). Must contain at least two names.

start_utc.description: Event start time in UTC, ISO 8601 format ending with Z (e.g. '2025-04-15T13:30:00Z').

duration_minutes.description: Length of the event in minutes.

title.description: Event title shown on all attendees' calendars. Defaults to 'Meeting' if omitted.

message.description: Human-readable error message (present only when status is 'error').

booking.description: Booking confirmation details (present only when status is 'success').

attendees.description: Display names of all booked attendees.

start_utc.description: Booked start in UTC ISO 8601 with Z.

end_utc.description: Booked end in UTC ISO 8601 with Z.
